result.reason: The amendment appropriately extends the Section 2.2 internal-use licence to affiliates and contractors with a limited change, but it does not extend the Section 2.1 hosting licence to them. It also leaves the fully paid-up Section 2.2 licence perpetual but not irrevocable, and the cross-reference to Section 14.1 does not affirmatively establish transferability to an M&A successor. Accordingly, the operative language reaches neither the full preferred position nor the complete fallback position.
